fields.System.Title: FDN-804 — Dead-letter handling
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a developer, I want permanently failing events moved aside and flagged, so that
one poisoned event does not block every event behind it.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given an event that has failed the configured number of times, then it is marked dead
  • and stops being retried.
  • - Given a dead event, then it retains its full payload and its last error.
  • - Given an event moves to dead, then an alert reaches a human.
  • - Given the underlying problem is fixed, then a dead event can be replayed.
  • - Given a dead event for one aggregate, then events for other aggregates continue to
  • deliver.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | platform |
| Tables | outbox |
| Risks | A poisoned event blocking the queue; dead letters nobody reviews ([doc 08 §6](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md)) |
| Tests | integration |
